row: | digestive_symptoms | Digestion, digestive symptoms & functional disorders | Everyday digestive complaints, functional gut disorders, non-allergic food sensitivities and intolerances, and digestion as a process (stomach acid, enzymes, motility, bowel regularity). Allergic reactions to food go to `immune.allergies`, elimination diets to `diets.elimination_therapeutic`, food-sensitivity test kits to `self_tracking.consumer_lab_tests`; reflux drugs also take `medications.other_drugs`, digestive-enzyme or betaine supplements `supplements.other_compounds`; H. pylori goes to `gut.gi_disease` and bile to `gut.liver_gallbladder`. | bloating; constipation; reflux; GERD; heartburn; IBS; SIBO; food intolerance; food sensitivities; lactose intolerance; low stomach acid; how many times a day we need to poop; gas |

| inflammation | Inflammation & oxidative stress as explanations | Inflammation or oxidative stress (free radicals, reactive oxygen species) invoked as a cause of disease or ageing, or as a property of foods, products and lifestyles, and markers of them. Local inflammation of an injured or diseased tissue (a swollen knee, an inflamed tendon) goes to that injury's or condition's subtopic; antioxidant supplements go to `supplements.other_compounds` and antioxidant foods to `food.plant_foods_fiber`. | chronic inflammation; systemic inflammation; inflammatory foods; anti-inflammatory diet; CRP; inflammaging; neuroinflammation; reduces inflammation; oxidative stress; reduce these free radicals |

| ocd_personality | OCD, intrusive thoughts, personality & factitious disorders | OCD and related disorders (body dysmorphia included), intrusive thoughts in the clinical sense, personality disorders and traits as clinical categories (psychopathy included), and factitious disorder (Munchausen syndrome; Munchausen by proxy also takes `acute_care.violence_abuse` as medical child abuse). Muscle dysmorphia goes to `manosphere.male_body_image`. Insults and loose description ("a narcissist", "a psychopath", "a little OCD", "intrusive thought" for a hot take, "Munchausen" as a jibe) are not health content. | OCD; exposure and response prevention; postpartum intrusive thoughts; body dysmorphia; borderline personality disorder; narcissistic personality disorder (as diagnosis); psychopathy; antisocial personality disorder; pathological lying; Munchausen syndrome by proxy |

| costs_insurance | Costs, insurance & health-care fraud | What care costs and who pays, including public programmes and fraud against public and private insurers. A prosecution or trial also takes `policy.health_law_courts`. | health insurance; claim denials; UnitedHealthcare; Medicaid; Medicare; ACA subsidies; medical debt; drug prices; Medicaid cuts; Medicare fraud; hospice fraud |

| saturated_fat_cholesterol_myth | Saturated fat and cholesterol do not cause heart disease | **Saturated fat, dietary cholesterol or blood (LDL) cholesterol do not cause heart disease.** The diet-heart or lipid hypothesis is called wrong or fraudulent, high LDL on a low-carb diet is called harmless, cholesterol is called a harmless repair molecule, or high cholesterol is said to mean longer life. Statin harm or uselessness is `narrative:statins_harmful`. | Ancel Keys fraud; butter is back; sugar industry blamed fat; LDL doesn't matter; cholesterol is not the bad guy; lean mass hyper-responders are healthy; insulin, not LDL, causes heart disease | food |

| germ_theory_denial | Germ theory is false / terrain theory | **Germs, or a specific pathogen, do not cause the disease attributed to them.** Viruses are said not to exist or not to be contagious and the "terrain" is all that matters, or a named pathogen is denied its role (HIV does not cause AIDS). Saying only that the body's terrain also matters, or naming terrain theory as an approach, is not this narrative. | germ theory is bogus; viruses don't exist; contagion is a myth; Pasteur recanted; HIV doesn't cause AIDS | infectious |

| psychiatric_care | Psychiatric care, hospitalization & forensic psychiatry | How psychiatric care is delivered, accessed and enforced: psychiatric hospitals and holds, involuntary commitment, asylums and deinstitutionalization, access to psychiatrists (psychiatric telehealth included), non-drug somatic treatments (ECT, TMS, stellate ganglion block, lobotomy as history), and psychiatric evaluation in the courts (insanity defense, competency). Drugs go to `mental.psychiatric_drugs`, talk therapy to `mental.therapy`, ketamine and psychedelics to `psychoactives`, general hospital care to `health_system.hospitals_access`; the person's condition also takes its own subtopic. "Insane asylum" as a jibe is not health content. | psych ward; 72-hour psychiatric hold; 5150; Baker Act; involuntary commitment; state mental hospital; deinstitutionalization; acquitted by reason of insanity; competent to stand trial; ECT; TMS; Talkiatry |
